author: ETA PRIME
description:
We installed SteamOS on the new MINISFORUM 895D7 and it runs everything! The new Low Profile RX 9060 XT with 16 GB VRAM is the ultimate GPU for SFF SteamOS builds, and in this video, we show you exactly what it can do and how it compares directly to the official Steam Machine.

Learn More Here: https://tidd.ly/4zF1lkP

This 8.47L SFF rig packs a 16-Core Ryzen 9 8945HX. The star of the show is the Vastarmor RX 9060 XT Low Profile, featuring the Navi 44 XT chip and RDNA 4.0 architecture. By tuning the TGP down to 140W from the standard 160W, this card is perfectly optimized for small form factor builds without sacrificing 16GB of VRAM.
